part_name: LM4040BIM3-5.0 (LM4040-N family, 2-terminal precision micropower shunt voltage reference, 5.0V nominal; model is grade B, +/-0.2% initial tolerance; SOT-23)
obtained_by: AI agent (bom-component-manager subagent) on behalf of roberto.carmeli@gmail.com
obtained_from: Downloaded with curl directly from ti.com (https://www.ti.com/lit/zip/snom508). The SPICE file is extracted unmodified from the ZIP. The datasheet is NOT duplicated here: it is the same SNOS633N document already frozen next to the 4.096 V model, at vendor/voltage_reference/ti/LM4040/lm4040.pdf (sha256 f3977fc3d89b4f25699e699ca2c89e0c00f45c84fc04e35692758b5390ac3880, 'SNOS633N - DECEMBER 1991 - REVISED AUGUST 2025'). NOTE: a fresh download of https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lm4040-n.pdf on 2026-10-25 has a different hash (c06c6337438bd950ee514ddd863070ab505f5d90e2dabf9ffc4c4a0843058ff6, 1980953 bytes vs 1980947): TI has re-issued the file; the page numbers cited by L57b are those of the frozen copy.
license_notes: Manufacturer SPICE model, redistributed here unmodified for engineering traceability only. Copyright remains Texas Instruments Incorporated.
why_this_part: L57b / ADR-101: the +5 V and -5 V references of the input limiter (two diodes per channel toward the references, threshold ~+/-5.6 V) must be SHUNT references so they can absorb the diode current in the fault (RCA hot-plug, <= 1.1 mA per channel). LM4040-5.0: I_RMIN 54 uA typ / 74 uA max, 15 mA max reverse current, Z_R 0.5 ohm typ / 1.1 ohm max at 1 mA, stable with any capacitive load (datasheet p. 1, p. 26, p. 5-6, p. 40).

files.role: SPICE model (PSpice transient transistor-level macromodel, Unencrypted), extracted unmodified from SNOM508.ZIP
files.header_says: '*LM4040_N / Part: LM4040_N / Date: 10APR2013 / Model Type: TRANSIENT / Simulator: PSPICE / Simulator Version: 16.0.0 / Datasheet: SNOS633G-MAY 2004-REVISED JULY 2012'. .SUBCKT LM4040_NB5P0 V+ V- PARAMS: TOL=0. Transistor-level, same topology as the 4.096 V model.

model_selection_note: The TI product page lists, for 5.0 V, LM4040_NA5P0 (PSpice Transient, encrypted; TINA-TI Transient) and LM4040_NB5P0 / NC5P0 (Unencrypted PSpice Transient). There is no unencrypted A-grade (+/-0.1%) 5.0 V model; NB5P0 (grade B, +/-0.2%) is the tightest unencrypted one. The part to BUY may be A or B grade; the model is the same transistor-level topology with TOL selecting the feedback resistor among three fixed values (TOL=0 -> 162223.6 ohm).

Adaptation done in models/voltage_reference/lm4040_5v0_ngspice.lib (see its provenance sidecar), never here.
spice_model_ngspice_verification.verdict: USABLE after the adaptation, for the operating point and Z_R; NOT for I_RMIN (model knee ~34 uA vs datasheet 54 typ / 74 max uA) and not for noise (not modelled). Numbers in models/voltage_reference/lm4040_5v0_ngspice.provenance.json.
